bundle_scope.topic: label/threshold parameters (OM decision threshold) and per-head loss-function + loss-weight parameters
bundle_scope.applies_to: every Optuna trial's label/head-loss configuration across every architecture-design candidate

options: OM > 1 — current resolved decision rule: a direction is a valid label only if MFE exceeds MAE (some favorable edge over adverse risk); tie-break picks the higher-OM direction
tier_1.rationale: already-resolved labeling rule every candidate trains against; stated as the Tier-1 default before any threshold sweep

options: MFE/MAE/OM bespoke scheme (supersedes old 3-way SL-hit/Timeout/TP label); horizon 240min; SL = max(worst adverse excursion before TP4, ATR floor = 1x ATR(255,15min)); fees enter only on the risk side (Risk = MAE x (1+F) x V, F=0.1%)
tier_1.rationale: already-resolved label design every candidate trains against

options: quantile/pinball loss (primary) + MAE/MSE companion - point formulation
tier_1.rationale: doc's baseline per-head loss for MAE/OM/MFE regression heads

options: cross-entropy vs class-weighted-CE vs focal - tuned per-target (peak/valley, TP-hit-before-SL), not one blanket choice; gamma/weights pending empirical prevalence measurement (not yet run)
tier_1.rationale: already-scoped per-head loss choice, explicitly flagged as needing per-target tuning once prevalence is measured

options: EMA-scale-normalized per-head weighted sum, weights themselves an Optuna-searched ~3-dim vector - not hand-fixed
tier_1.rationale: already-resolved method: normalize per-head losses by a running EMA of their native scale before weighting, then search the weight vector itself as an Optuna dimension

options: OM > 2 - more conservative label definitions, fewer but higher-edge trades
tier_2.rationale: no doc evidence for these specific values; natural sweep around the resolved OM>1 rule once prevalence/backtested-KPI data exists to justify it, not adopted speculatively
tier_2.source_anchor: n/a - not named in doc, listed for search-space completeness only

options: distributional NLL, moments added incrementally: Gaussian (mean+std) -> skew-normal/Johnson-SU (+skew) -> skew-t/Pearson-system (+kurtosis)
tier_2.rationale: named alternative formulation to the point/quantile baseline; also the doc's preferred fix for the open confidence-metric gap since it could derive TP/SL risk estimates from the fitted distribution directly

options: Brier score vs log-loss, plus calibration curve/ECE as a diagnostic (not primary)
tier_2.rationale: named alternative for the probability/confidence head, secondary since no input feature carries confidence information today (open gap)

options: homoscedastic task-uncertainty weighting (Kendall et al.) - learned log-variance per head, dynamically re-weights losses during training instead of a fixed searched value
tier_2.rationale: named well-established, cheap-to-add alternative to the static-search baseline, worth testing head-to-head, not assumed superior

options: specific gamma/weight numeric values - not yet determinable, blocked on the prevalence-measurement data-profiling script that hasn't run yet
tier_3.rationale: doc explicitly defers concrete numbers until prevalence is measured empirically; premature to fabricate specific gamma values now

options: secondary GBM classifier on a binary 'is OM above threshold' label, gating whether to act on the primary model's signal
tier_3.rationale: named GBM-family role (Lopez de Prado meta-labeling), a genuinely separate second-stage mechanism rather than a loss/threshold parameter on the primary heads - parked here for completeness, gated behind the primary single-stage model per training-strategy-selection's default

optimization_mechanics.search_method: loss-weight vector and any per-head loss-function categorical choice are Optuna dims within the same single study as architecture+hparams; OM-threshold sweep and prevalence-driven gamma values are separate, cheaper GBM-proxy iterations before a full DL retrain (per class-imbalance handling)
optimization_mechanics.pruning: Hyperband via OptunaPruningCallback, same as every other dimension in the study
optimization_mechanics.budget_control: reserve multi-seed re-run budget for top finalists post-search only, per statistical validity of comparisons
